description: Real-time strategy: pointer selection, camera pan/zoom, many commands.

zoom.evidence: Emulator, 2026-11-23, skirmish map: injected pinch-out and pinch-in produced touch wheel +120 and -120 events through hle_input_wheel, and the camera did not change between ra2_map_start.png and ra2_map_pinch_in.png. Yuri's Revenge ignores the mouse wheel for zoom. Port-side magnification (method present) is not built.

input.engineFacts: Verified in port source (src/nx/main.c, launcher.cpp): two-finger drag pans the camera, long press and two-finger tap send a right click, nothing handles pinch. The mouse wheel is only forwarded as WM_MOUSEWHEEL. Not yet tested in the running game: whether Yuri's Revenge reacts to the wheel. Until tested, pinch uses the present method (port-side magnification).

scroll.note: A two-finger drag that starts in the right 20% of the screen sends the wheel (lists and the sidebar); elsewhere it pans the camera.

performance.notes: Frame rate on device not yet measured. Preset caps apply until measured. Values mirror src/nx/launcher.cpp defaults.

scenarios.title: Select a unit, then order it to move

steps.gamepad: Move pointer with left stick, A to select, X to command
steps.touch: Tap the unit, long-press the ground
steps.kbm: Left click the unit, right click the ground

scenarios.title: Move the camera across the map

steps.kbm: Mouse at screen edge or W A S D

scenarios.title: Zoom in and out (when zoom is enabled)

steps.gamepad: Hold ZR and move the stick
steps.touch: Drag with one finger on empty ground

scenarios.title: Open the menu and cancel with the same device
